summary: Backend: ran the 4 requested pytest suites (test_fzr_composite_fulfillment, test_fzr_multiline, test_fzr_phase3, test_fzr_uc_audit) -> 71 passed / 0 failed, 1 warning (unrelated PendingDeprecationWarning from starlette). Frontend: verified the Admin decomposition display for MGS-DEMO01/02/03 in the orders list. All three orders render as specified: correct 'Envoyer au fournisseur (N)' counters (2 / 1 / 3), Composition badge on the composite 720 UC parent line, nested component rows (660 UC + 60 UC) with pending 'À envoyer' badges, completed component in DEMO02 with provider id 'ord-demo-660', DEMO03 correctly shows 2 client lines (720 UC 44 500 Ar + 60 UC 4 500 Ar = 49 000 Ar) with the direct 60 UC line rendered as a single '○ À envoyer' row (no composition). ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /admin/commandes?order=MGS-DEMO01 (and DEMO02/DEMO03) shows 'Order not found'. The page calls GET /api/orders/{focusedOrder} which only matches by internal UUID `id` field, not by `order_number`. So the notification/deeplink flow using order_number always 404s for admins. Workaround used during testing: search by order_number in the list. Not part of the composite feature itself but blocks the requested URL flow.

action_items: (Optional / out of composite scope) Make GET /api/orders/{id_or_number} also resolve by order_number, OR change the frontend focused fetch to /admin/orders/{id} + resolve order_number server-side, so the /admin/commandes?order=MGS-DEMO01 deeplink works. Everything else is passing.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routers/orders.py get_order() matches only by `id`; add order_number fallback for admins to support notification deeplinks.
Seeded demo orders have user_id=None and email=None; they work in admin list view via search but fail single-order deeplink due to the id-only lookup.
Composite decomposition rendering in FzrFulfillment.js correctly uses data-testids fzr-comp-<order>-<idx>-<u> and fzr-comp-status-* — good testability.
Send button counter (readyCount) correctly aggregates units across composite and direct lines (DEMO01=2, DEMO02=1 after 1 completed, DEMO03=3).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for the composite display; 1 unrelated deeplink bug found

When re-testing, note that ?order=MGS-DEMO01 deeplink 404s because /api/orders/{id} only accepts UUID id — use the search box (MGS-DEMO01/02/03) to load the orders in list view. rca of the issue: Deeplink 'Order not found': frontend calls GET /api/orders/MGS-DEMO01 (order_number), but backend routers/orders.py:247 does db.orders.find_one({'id': order_id}) — matches only the internal UUID `id` field, never the human-readable `order_number`. Fix: extend lookup to `{'$or':[{'id':order_id},{'order_number':order_id}]}` for admin roles, or add a dedicated /admin/orders/by-number/{n} endpoint.
